items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I was with Jelly Roll. I had to get with somebody. I met him at the Rhythm Club down here, and he had heard me play when I was with Claude and he said, you're not doing anything? I said I'm not; you are now.

ctx.x: Yeah, I was with Jelly Roll. I had to get with somebody. I met him at the Rhythm Club down here, and he had heard me play when I was with Claude and he said, you're not doing anything? I said I'm not; you are now.
That's the way he was. Then Fletcher had to go--that's when I went and joined Fletcher, but we only played Yale, Harvard--
